hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 and CST9220 touch controller.

inputs.name: Static FFS RAM root
inputs.revision: Console tools with wscons and I²C reader

scenario: Boot the test kernel with a RAM root and read the native wsmouse event stream while the operator moves a finger on the touch panel.
expected: Contact and release events and changing absolute X and Y coordinates reach the native wsmouse device.
observed: The operator reported several finger movements. The wsmouse event stream contained changing absolute X and Y coordinates and contact/release events.
limits: One assembled V1.2 sample; this RAM boot did not update the installed NOR image.
The event capture establishes input delivery, not orientation, calibration accuracy, multitouch or sustained reliability.
The screen remained completely black in the separate graphics trial; touch input does not establish visible display output.
The escaped event stream and local device details remain private.
